zh: Strange Rules（奇异规则，威尼斯 Palazzo Diedo，2026）
desc_en: Exhibition curated by Mat Dryhurst, Holly Herndon and Hans Ulrich Obrist with Adriana Rispoli for Berggruen Arts & Culture (4 May – 22 November 2026) that introduces Protocol Art, with works by artists and researchers who write rules; a book on Protocol Art is being researched during the show.
desc_zh: 由 Mat Dryhurst、Holly Herndon 与 Hans Ulrich Obrist 联合 Adriana Rispoli 为 Berggruen Arts & Culture 策划的展览（2026 年 5 月 4 日至 11 月 22 日），提出“协议艺术”的概念，展出编写规则的艺术家与研究者的作品；一本关于协议艺术的书在展期内同步研究写作。
